framework_reviews.title: Enterprise Asset Inventory Review
framework_reviews.source_cadence: 1.1: six-month inventory review; 1.2: weekly operational handling, not weekly human Review
framework_reviews.reason: Group related validation work into one authoritative Review while retaining each safeguard's source semantics.

framework_reviews.title: Software Authorization & Support Review
framework_reviews.source_cadence: 2.2, 2.3 and 12.1: monthly review; 2.1: six-month inventory review; 9.1: implementation state
framework_reviews.reason: Group related validation work into one authoritative Review while retaining each safeguard's source semantics.

framework_reviews.title: Data Management & Inventory Review
framework_reviews.source_cadence: 3.1, 3.2: annual review; significant change also triggers 3.1; other safeguards provide supporting context
framework_reviews.reason: Group related validation work into one authoritative Review while retaining each safeguard's source semantics.

framework_reviews.title: Secure Configuration Process Review
framework_reviews.source_cadence: 4.1, 4.2: annual documentation review and significant change
framework_reviews.reason: Group related validation work into one authoritative Review while retaining each safeguard's source semantics.

framework_reviews.title: Account Authorization & Access Review
framework_reviews.source_cadence: 5.1: quarterly authorization validation; 5.3: 45-day operational inactivity threshold; 6.1/6.2: event-driven
framework_reviews.reason: Group related validation work into one authoritative Review while retaining each safeguard's source semantics.

framework_reviews.title: Vulnerability & Remediation Process Review
framework_reviews.source_cadence: 7.2: monthly process review; 7.1: annual/change review; 7.3/7.4: monthly operational patching
framework_reviews.reason: Group related validation work into one authoritative Review while retaining each safeguard's source semantics.

framework_reviews.title: Audit Log Management Process Review
framework_reviews.reason: Group related validation work into one authoritative Review while retaining each safeguard's source semantics.
framework_reviews.ig2_operating_context: 8.11: actual log examination at least weekly; 8.10: at least 90 days retention. An annual governance meeting is insufficient to perform these duties.

framework_reviews.title: Data Recovery Governance Review
framework_reviews.source_cadence: 11.1: annual/change process review; 11.2: weekly operational backups, not a weekly human Review
framework_reviews.reason: Group related validation work into one authoritative Review while retaining each safeguard's source semantics.
framework_reviews.ig2_operating_context: 11.5: execute sampled recovery tests at least quarterly. Keep annual governance and separately link dated quarterly restore results.

framework_reviews.title: Security Awareness Program Review
framework_reviews.source_cadence: 14.1: annual/change content review and training at hire/annually; remaining safeguards are training topics
framework_reviews.reason: Group related validation work into one authoritative Review while retaining each safeguard's source semantics.

framework_reviews.title: Service Provider Inventory Review
framework_reviews.source_cadence: 15.1: annual inventory review and significant change; not a separate assurance review for every vendor
framework_reviews.reason: Group related validation work into one authoritative Review while retaining each safeguard's source semantics.

framework_reviews.title: Incident Reporting & Contact Review
framework_reviews.source_cadence: 17.1–17.3: annual personnel, contact and reporting-process review; significant change for 17.1/17.3
framework_reviews.reason: Group related validation work into one authoritative Review while retaining each safeguard's source semantics.

framework_reviews.title: Endpoint Protection Validation
framework_reviews.source_cadence: No prescribed human-review interval; quarterly validation is an Omnisciente recommendation
framework_reviews.reason: Periodically validate implementation without turning automatic operational activity into a mandated Review.

framework_reviews.title: Network Defense Validation
framework_reviews.source_cadence: Operational intervals and event triggers remain safeguard-specific; this Review evaluates actual execution and follow-up.
framework_reviews.reason: Group related work without replacing external technical activity or automatically changing an existing schedule.

framework_reviews.title: Secure Development & Component Review
framework_reviews.source_cadence: Operational intervals and event triggers remain safeguard-specific; this Review evaluates actual execution and follow-up.
framework_reviews.reason: Group related work without replacing external technical activity or automatically changing an existing schedule.
framework_reviews.ig2_operating_context: 16.4: component evaluation at least monthly; 16.9: developer training at least annually; lifecycle and reporting duties continue between Reviews.

framework_reviews.title: External Penetration Testing Program Review
framework_reviews.source_cadence: Operational intervals and event triggers remain safeguard-specific; this Review evaluates actual execution and follow-up.
framework_reviews.reason: Group related work without replacing external technical activity or automatically changing an existing schedule.
framework_reviews.ig2_operating_context: 18.2: qualified external testing at least annually, including reconnaissance; 18.3: risk-prioritized remediation. A Review alone is not a penetration test.
